summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; COUNSEL_REQUIRED for upstream data rights, personal-data processing, notification delivery, vendor/DPA, jurisdiction, and future affiliate/advertising use. Keep SearchWoot private and keep rights outreach unsent. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access and rate limits, but not redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, public display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, or commercial rights; public terms restrict product-listing, price, derivative, and data-mining use. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, owner, and privacy gates are also incomplete. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.

Launch-readiness data-use dispositions: (1) Woot API deal and price-history data — BLOCKED pending current written permission or API agreement, field-level rights, retention/display/alert terms, provenance, freshness, correction, takedown, and claims controls. Smallest next action: attach the authoritative rights record or prepare—but do not send—the owner-approved counsel packet. (2) User alert rules and sync results — COUNSEL_REQUIRED pending data inventory, retention/deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe evidence. Smallest next action: complete a read-only data-flow and retention table from the repository and deployed configuration. (3) GA4 analytics — CONDITIONAL for measurement-only use, not remarketing or advertising; evidence shows consent-gated intent and privacy/cookie files, but deployed consent behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdiction review are missing. Smallest next action: capture those settings read-only without enabling tracking. (4) Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — EVIDENCE_NEEDED; operational use may continue only within existing controls, but log fields, retention/access, vendor terms/DPA, incident, and data-subject-request procedures are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce the operator/vendor inventory and flag counsel-required gaps. No item is clear for public monetization or rights-dependent display.

Compliance and data-quality disposition: do not block ordinary reversible growth solely because telemetry is incomplete, provided it adds no new data collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, cross-site behavior, or public exposure. The compliance baseline is technical only: 36 pass, 19 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Data quality is green for registry, operational checkouts, analytics, SEO, and AI usage; revenue attribution is yellow because $4.92 commission is aggregate and unattributed for 2026-09-21. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, forecast, or causal lift.

Private and gated-site decision: keep SearchWoot private. Do not authorize bounded public beta, full launch, affiliate/advertising expansion, external rights outreach, or new collection. For scaffold launch candidates, allow preview-only readiness documentation only; do not publish. complicated.work remains blocked by failed banner/consent/GA4 checks, analytics not configured, and incomplete security and owner evidence. deadlymaracas.com is not launch-cleared because reachability and compliance evidence are unavailable. No go-live proposal is supported.

Claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, affiliate disclosure, and age-sensitive review boundary: no rights-dependent Woot claims, prices, images, savings claims, alerts, affiliate links, advertising, or public derivative display may be enabled until source permission and field-level rules are evidenced and reviewed by human counsel. Existing ordinary site growth may proceed only with existing disclosures and no unsupported claims. No evidence supports a legal clearance or certification.
